whatsappMessage:
Hi Team The Light House Cafe,

I noticed your cafe has stellar 4.8★ reviews near IIT Patna in Bihta, but lacked a dedicated mobile page for table reservations and menu exploration.

Maine aapke cafe ke liye ek custom live website concept design kiya hai — jisme direct WhatsApp table booking, signature cafe menu, aur location directions integrate kiye hain:

🔗 https://www.arclanestudios.space/sites/lighthousecafe

Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Would love your honest feedback!

— Ameya Sharma, Arclane Studios
callScript: "Hi Team The Light House Cafe, Ameya here from Arclane Studios. Maine aapke cafe (The Light House Cafe) ke liye ek custom live website concept banakar WhatsApp par share kiya tha. Bas ek minute check karna tha ki kya aapko link receive hua aur aapne demo glance kiya? Great! We tailored it specifically with direct WhatsApp table booking, mobile-first speed, and a showcase of your stellar 4.8★ rating near IIT Bihta. Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Agar aapko concept aur design direction pasand aaye, to hum isme aapki exact menu items, actual photos aur contact setup integrate karke live kar sakte hain. Jab bhi aap free hon batayein, we can connect on a quick 5-minute walkthrough."
